Definition: {a flag; also a sail; by implication, a flagstaff; generally a signal; figuratively, a token}
BiblicalUsage: Kec means a throne, a seat of honour. Exodus 17:16 says, because the LORD hath sworn that the LORD will have war with Amalek, the hand upon the throne of the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Amalek's war was against the throne itself, and that is why the LORD swore it would last from generation to generation.
